problem: Eligibility and selection use aggregate acceptable answers. On a mixed bank an always-abstaining candidate can earn positive counts solely from unanswerable cases, despite no complete supported answerable response. The existing all-abstention fixture contains only answerable questions and misses this route.
authority: The already frozen docs/goal-loop.md contract explicitly forbids always-abstaining from producing a passing result. This corrects software to the existing policy; it does not introduce a course threshold or relax an acceptance rule.
proposed_correction: Keep every observed answer/refusal and all quality counts. Exclude candidates with zero acceptable answerable responses from nomination and selection, including after whole-answer vetoes. At least one such response is necessary, not sufficient for Goal completion.
acceptance: A mixed answerable/unanswerable all-abstaining fixture must be rejected by primary nomination, whole-answer nomination and the actual selector. Correct unanswerable counts stay present. A supported answerable candidate remains selectable. Removing its only answerable success through an unknown whole-answer judgment leaves no eligible winner.
next_action: Continue generation and retrieval diagnostics under the existing quality gates. No current useful candidate or full development winner exists; the evaluator fix cannot establish R04 completion.
